decisions.reason: Selecting 154Q as the displayed site name does not change the existing $8,880 allocation or its full-program-allocation basis.
The site-name decision does not alter any service dates, session times, service days, or the sections to which the FCC date range applies.
The decision to display 154Q does not change the required four-week value for Annex B.
The funding and hosting relationship explains the site naming but does not change the established session-based labor calculation method or inputs.
The 154Q display-name decision does not change the existing Queens Collegiate explanation concerning full allocated budget versus subcontract amount.
The displayed site name and funding-location relationship do not affect the requirement to sign the subcontractor section.
The site-name choice does not change how the budget gap must be allocated or which non-personnel categories are permitted.
Using 154Q as the agreement name does not alter whether the salary and wages support sheet must be included.
